title: Alkoholisierter Mann schlägt Nachbarn, greift Polizeibeamte an und leistet Widerstand bei Festnahme – DEIG-Einsatz

extraction.summaryEn: A drunk man hit his neighbour with a key ring in a residential building in Gesundbrunnen, then resisted arrest and was subdued with a stun device (DEIG). Police officers were not injured.
